issues.issue: Whether the claimant's account of her UK trip and her parents' absence is credible
issues.applicant_position: Claimant says her parents left her with her sister and she went to England in 2008 to find them.
issues.result_text: Claimant's story about her UK trip and stay is not credible.

issues.issue: Whether the feared conjugal partner is established as an agent of harm
issues.applicant_position: Claimant says her boyfriend became abusive and controlling after she returned and knocked her unconscious.
issues.result_text: Claimant failed to establish the identity of the feared partner; account not credible.

issues.issue: Whether there is credible evidence supporting any s.96 or s.97 fear
issues.result_text: No credible evidence supports the alleged fear; claim rejected.
